reviews: Three tacos for a few bucks, and we pushed two long tables together for the whole study group.
Asked about nuts for my roommate. Staff said there's not a peanut in the building.
The tacos come drowning in their house mole, rich and nutty, made with ground peanuts. Dirt cheap too.
Big booths that fit eight of us easily. Perfect for a birthday crew.
Fancy little tacos with fancy little prices. Tasty, but not student-budget friendly.
Huge communal tables upstairs, so our whole team fit. Menu says it's a nut-free kitchen.
Smash burgers and fries, nothing else, and you'll barely spend ten bucks. Don't come looking for tacos.
Rows of picnic benches inside, easy to grab one for a big group. No peanuts anywhere on the menu.
